contents.config.title: Merge Conflict
contents.config.autoNavigateNextConflictEnabled: Apakah akan automatically navigate to the next merge conflict after resolving a merge conflict.
contents.config.codeLensEnabled: buat a CodeLens untuk merge conflict blocks within editor.
contents.config.decoratorsEnabled: buat decorators untuk merge conflict blocks within editor.
contents.config.diffViewPosition: Mengontrol where the diff tampilan should be dibuka when comparing changes in merge conflicts.
contents.config.diffViewPosition.current: buka the diff tampilan in the saat ini editor grup.
contents.config.diffViewPosition.beside: buka the diff tampilan next to the saat ini editor grup.
contents.config.diffViewPosition.below: buka the diff tampilan below the saat ini editor grup.
